mapper.select: SELECT lm.system_code , lm.menu_id , lm.menu_name , lm.program_name , lm.menu_level_no , lm.sort_order_no , lm.high_menu_id , NVL2(lrm.role_code, 'Y', 'N') yn_flag , lrm.role_code FROM LGCOM_MENU_R_V lm , LGCOM_ROLE_MENU_N lrm WHERE lm.menu_id = lrm.menu_id(+) AND lrm.role_code(+) = #{roleCode} AND lm.display_flag = 'Y' AND lm.system_code = #{systemCode} AND lm.module_code = #{moduleCode} ORDER BY lm.system_code, lm.menu_order_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LGCOM_ROLE_MENU_N VALUES(#{roleCode}, #{menuId}, #{sessionUserId}, SYSDATE, #{sessionUserId}, SYSDATE)
